# What's new in 0.3.3

Released **2026-10-03**. Full project history: [CHANGELOG.md](../../CHANGELOG.md).

## Highlights

- **Heart rate on macOS.** Settings can discover, connect, and disconnect a Garmin HRM-Pro or other Bluetooth heart-rate strap. Autoconnect remembers the strap; Disconnect pauses it.
- The ride screen shows bpm next to cadence. There is no heart-rate chart.
- The Raspberry Pi build does not include this. The Heart rate section stays hidden there.

## Installer

- `steadyGrind-0.3.3-macos.dmg` (this folder)
- GitHub Release: https://github.com/attilameget/HomeWlanTrainer/releases/tag/v0.3.3

Allow Bluetooth the first time you Discover or Connect a strap.
